# A package whose name the generated code declares (request, td, ...) or
# the output package declares (templates, the templates variable) is
# imported under an alias, so the handlers that spell its types compile.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.24
-- request/request.go --
package request

type Thing struct{ Name string }
-- td/td.go --
package td

type Count int
-- templates/templates.go --
package templates

type Title string
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"example.com/app/request"
	"example.com/app/td"
	titles "example.com/app/templates"
)

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Thing() request.Thing { return request.Thing{Name: "thing"} }

func (Server) Count() td.Count { return 3 }

func (Server) Title() titles.Title { return "title" }
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /thing Thing()"}}{{.Result.Name}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /count Count()"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
{{define "GET /title Title()"}}{{.Result}}{{end}}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestImportsNamedLikeGeneratedLocals(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})
	for path, want := range map[string]string{"/thing": "thing", "/count": "3", "/title": "title"} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil))
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK || rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("GET %s = %d %q, want 200 %q", path, rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	}
}
